spans.s:
Frigid, freezing, cold.
n. (-मं)
Hoar-frost.
f. (-मी)
Yellow jasmine.
E.
हेमन् gold, or हिम frost, अण् aff.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
1 Cold, wintry.
2 Growing in winter.
2 Suitable to winter.
m. (-नः)
The month Mārgaśīrṣa.
n. (-नं)
The winter season.
E.
हेमन्त winter, अण् aff., and the final optionally rejected.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं)
1 Wintry, cold.
2 Growing in winter, &c.
3 Suitable to the winter, (as abode or clothing, &c.)
n. (-न्तं)
The winter season.
E.
हेमन्त winter, अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Wintry, freezing, frigid.
E.
हेमन्त, and ठक् aff.

mn. (-लः-लं)
Winter.
E.
हिमल cold, अण् aff.

n. (-तं)
Bharata Varṣa or India.
m. (-तः)
A sort of poison.
f. (-ती)
1 PĀRVATĪ.
2 Chebulic myrobalan.
3 A medicinal kind of moon-plant.
4 A white kind of Orris root.
5 The Ganges.
E.
हिसवत् the snowy mountains skirting India, अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीप्.
